translation: It treats the five hemorrhoids (五痔), erosion of the genitals (陰蝕), discharge of red and white blood (下血赤白), blood and sap that flows without stopping of five colors (五色血汁不止), swelling of the genitals (陰腫), pain that draws to the lumbus and back (痛引腰背); boiled in wine it kills them (酒煮殺之). It grows [at/within] [blank].
